declared_convention_sources.title: ASM International — One Minute Mentor: Carbonitriding
declared_convention_sources.claim_used: Carbonitriding is a shallow case-hardening treatment; depths above 0.5 mm are seldom specified and the cycle is commonly followed by quench-based martensitic hardening.

declared_convention_sources.title: TWI — What is carburising / carbonitriding?
declared_convention_sources.claim_used: Carbonitriding is applicable to steels up to about 0.4–0.5% bulk carbon and combines carbon and nitrogen diffusion before heat treatment.

declared_convention_sources.title: TWI — What is plasma carburising / plasma nitriding?
declared_convention_sources.claim_used: Effective nitriding depends on nitride-forming alloying elements; therefore plain SAE 1030 does not justify nitriding as the default answer from the condition alone.

review_reasoning: SAE 1030 has approximately 0.30% carbon, which lies inside the cited carbonitriding applicability range.
The requested 100 micrometers equals 0.10 mm and is a shallow case, consistent with carbonitriding.
Plain SAE 1030 does not declare the alloying additions needed to make nitriding the default route.
The exact time, atmosphere, quench, temper and achieved 230 HB profile cannot be calculated from the problem statement and must remain process-qualification parameters.
reviewed_exam_answer_ru: Применить контролируемое неглубокое химико-термическое упрочнение поверхности — предпочтительно карбонитрирование (допустимый учебный вариант: короткая цементация) — затем закалку и отпуск. Время и режим подбирают для эффективной глубины около 0,10 мм, после чего микротвёрдостью подтверждают примерно 230 HB на поверхности при сохранении сердцевины около 170 HB. Из условия нельзя вычислить конкретные температуру и время процесса.
